Question
========
The principle of purpose limitation means that data must:

Answerlist
----------
* Be deleted immediately after collection
* Be collected for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes
* Be shared with authorities
* Be processed only inside Germany


Solution
========
The principle of purpose limitation means that data must be collected for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
